scope.work: The Divine Liturgy of St John Chrysostom

start.locator: The work begins midway down the surface at the large black heading: قداس يوحنا. Earlier material remains above it on the same surface.

end.locator: The dismissal ends near the bottom of the surface with: امين.

next_work.work: The Divine Liturgy of St Basil
next_work.locator: The next work begins at the large black heading: قداس باسليوس.

scope.reading_order: Within each correctly oriented spread, read the right surface before the left surface.

requirements: Preserve the manuscript's spelling, letter forms expressible in Unicode, punctuation, sparse vocalization, and rubrication.
Record uncertain readings explicitly. Do not silently repair grammar, spelling, liturgical wording, or damaged text.
Keep any normalized comparison in a separate field and never substitute it for the diplomatic transcription.
Every segment must name its PDF page, LOC image ID, image side, visible folio mark when present, and image region.
No segment may be aligned or published until a second qualified Arabic reader verifies every character and mark against the scan.

segments.locator: Two checked excerpts: the large black heading and the first black prayer clause near the bottom of the surface. The red rubric between them is not transcribed here.

runs.text: يا من ارسلت يسوع المسيح ربنا

segments.punctuation_note: The red point after الهنا is represented by U+00B7 and a red color run. It is not a modern period.
